01In August 2025 we completed another turnkey job, this time in Suchdol nad Lužnicí.
In August 2025 we completed another turnkey job, this time in Suchdol nad Lužnicí. For a family house we supplied and commissioned a BioCleaner BC 4 OPTIMA in the polypropylene (PP) version.

The project included excavation work, positioning of the treatment plant, joining up the pipework and complete hook-up to the sewer connection. Thanks to well-coordinated work, the installation went ahead without complications.

The customer has thus gained a modern, environmentally friendly and reliable wastewater treatment solution that will provide convenient operation with minimal maintenance costs.
